periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axis is oriented at approximately a 60-degree inward angle toward the snout relative to the horizontal facial midline.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: The patches exhibit an elongated oval geometry with a vertical height approximately twice the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: There is a pronounced downward tapering where the patch extends significantly further toward the muzzle from the geometric center than toward the forehead.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The ears are widely spaced across the cranial vault, with the inter-pinna gap measuring approximately double the width of a single ear base.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The superior boundaries of the ears are convex and generally rounded, though the fur texture creates a slightly irregular, fuzzy perimeter rather than a sharp geometric curve.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct region of brownish-tan discolored fur is visible across the central and lower abdominal area, contrasting with the standard white ventral fur.
